item.description:
Release v5.6.2

Changes since v5.6.1

  • feat(agentturnrunner): resume incomplete tool-call batches after suspension
  • feat(caffeinate): make duration & quick action sections self-contained
  • feat(caffeinate): track display-off request and toggle via menu bar popup
  • feat(conversation): add attention indicators for unread conversations
  • feat(conversation): expose isLoadingConversations via ConversationManaging
  • feat(conversation): pulse attention dot while agent turn is running
  • feat(conversationlist): show project path before updated time with divider
  • feat(llmkit): merge tool results and forward reasoning for anthropic adapter
  • feat(logo): expose menu-bar highlight state on logo services
  • feat(lumifactory): apply themed appearance and bridge window background
  • feat(lumifactory): render panel bottom divider via appSplitDivider
  • feat(menubar): apply themed background and close popover on app resign active
  • feat(menubar): close popover on space change and outside clicks
  • feat(menubar): expose color scheme parameter on popup view
  • feat(menubar): highlight menu bar logo while caffeinate is active
  • feat(menubar): make MenuBarPopupView sections self-contained and reuse shared MenuBarActionRow
  • feat(menubar): observe system appearance and sync popover scheme
  • feat(messagelist): add turn activity snapshot
  • feat(messagelist): aggregate tool activity by turn
  • feat(messagelist): identify turn activity rows
